ai.en: Hello! Can I help you?

ai.zh: 往前走，车站在学校旁边。
ai.en: Go straight ahead. The station is next to the school.
Not far, ten minutes on foot.
Good. Please go straight ahead; do not turn right.
You are welcome! Goodbye!

you.en: Excuse me, where is the station?

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to drink?

ai.zh: 好的。你想喝热的还是冷的？
ai.en: Okay. Would you like it hot or cold?

ai.zh: 好。你想吃东西吗？我们有面。
ai.en: Okay. Would you like something to eat? We have noodles.
Okay. Forty yuan.
Thank you! Goodbye!
Hello! What is wrong with you?
Have you eaten today?

ai.zh: 你要多休息。这个药，一天吃三次。
ai.en: You need to rest more. Take this medicine three times a day.
Take it after you finish eating.
You are welcome, goodbye!

you.en: I have a headache and I do not feel well.

you.zh: 吃了，但是我不想吃东西。
you.en: I ate, but I do not want anything to eat.
Okay, when do I take it?

ai.en: Hello! What are your hobbies?
Do you swim often?
Great! Do you like playing basketball?

ai.zh: 我也喜欢足球！我们一起踢吧。
ai.en: I like soccer too! Let us play together.
Wonderful!

you.zh: 我喜欢游泳，我也喜欢跳舞。
you.en: I like swimming, and I like dancing too.

you.zh: 不太喜欢，我喜欢踢足球。
you.en: Not really; I like playing soccer.

ai.en: Hello! Where are you going?
Okay. What time is your flight?

ai.zh: 没问题。路上不远，我们很快就到。
ai.en: No problem. It is not far, we will be there soon.
Okay. We have arrived!
One hundred yuan.

you.en: I am going to the airport.
Great, please drive a little faster.

scenarios.title: A friend's birthday
goals: Say what you want to drink

ai.en: Today is my birthday!

ai.zh: 谢谢！你真好。你想喝茶还是咖啡？
ai.en: Thank you! You are so kind. Would you like tea or coffee?

ai.zh: 我们一起去饭馆吃饭吧。
ai.en: Let us go to a restaurant together.
Six in the evening, next to the station.
Great, see you in the evening!

you.zh: 生日快乐！我送你一本书。
you.en: Happy birthday! I am giving you a book.
Okay, I will be there at six.

scenarios.title: Talk about an exam
goals: Say what you are doing and ask for help

ai.zh: 明天有汉语考试，你准备好了吗？
ai.en: There is a Chinese exam tomorrow. Have you prepared?
What are you doing now?
Sure, I will teach you.
This word means friend.
You are welcome, see you tomorrow.

you.en: Not yet, and I am a little tired.

you.zh: 我正在看书，你可以帮我吗？
you.en: I am reading. Can you help me?

scenarios.title: Buy trousers
goals: Say what you want to buy
Say it is too big and ask for a smaller one

ai.en: Hello! What would you like to buy?
What colour do you like?
How about this one?

ai.zh: 有。这条小的很漂亮，二百块。
ai.en: Yes. This small one is very nice, two hundred yuan.
Okay, one hundred and eighty yuan.

you.en: I want to buy a pair of trousers.
It is a bit big. Do you have a smaller one?
That is too expensive, make it cheaper.

phrases.en: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

phrases.zh: 你说得太快了，我听不懂。
phrases.en: You speak too fast; I cannot understand.
I do not know how to say it.
